notes.title: Mining Merchant Devlog #1: The Basics
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In the coming time leading up to release I'll be posting a series of devblogs to spotlight certain elements of my upcoming game Mining Merchant.

I figured for the first post, I’d start with the basics of the game and go over the core gameplay loop. From here on, I’ll cover each element in a dedicated devblog. So with this one, I aim to give you a bit of an overview of the game and what’s to come.

👉Before we get into it, please add the game to your Steam wishlist to be notified when it launches!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744080/Mining_Merchant/"][/dynamiclink]
[h3]The basics[/h3]
In Mining Merchant, your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life. The core gameplay loop is like this: 
Mining → Crafting → Shopkeeping → Upgrading → Repeat! 
All while the story progresses alongside every stage. Let’s go over each part in more detail.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/ed86f689d9d914c1e7d8b5e513d60382b6f92bd2.gif"][/img]

[h3]Mining[/h3]
The day starts when you wake up and hop in your truck to head to a mining location of your choice. Once there, you select your mech and companion bot, and get to mining!

Each mech and companion bot has their own ability. 
[list][*]Mechs have active abilities like Rock Breaker (which breaks any rock on screen) or Resource Magnet (which instantly collects all resources on screen).
[*]Companion bots have passive abilities like Magnify (10% chance to double collected resources) or Dirtbag (10% chance that collected dirt is destroyed instead of stored).[/list]
New in Mining Merchant is a leveling system! You now gain exp as you mine resources, earning skill points with each level-up. These points can be used to improve your mining stats, which apply to any mech you use. So every mech has its own pros and cons throughout the whole game.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/ba57e1f7155fcde71d2993fb560d30826b46fec9.gif"][/img]

[h3]Crafting[/h3]
After extracting resources from underground, you’re ready to craft them into valuable jewelry to sell in your store. The crafting process consists of several stages: 
[list][*]Smelting: turn raw metals into ingots
[*]Smithing: shape ingots into basic jewelry like rings and bracelets
[*]Gem Setting: add valuable gems to your jewelry pieces
[*]Packaging: polish and package your pieces to increase their value![/list]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/8d362750686f5eec8280ab385a131a0afb255e12.gif"][/img]

[h3]Shopkeeping[/h3]
Once you've mined your resources and crafted them into valuable jewerly, it's time to return to your shop and make some money. Select which jewerly pieces you want to stock up and put on display, clean up, add some decorations and open up shop!

Customers will walk in to see if you've got something on display that they like. This can get hectic! Make sure your displays are stocked, help customers check out before they get impatient, and clean up trash to keep customers happy. Some customers will request custom orders from you and will return the next day to pick it up.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/cfa50114810b4fac2a06add5b46349f7d16d1734.gif"][/img]

[h3]Upgrades[/h3]
Once we've earned some exp and made some money, it's time to upgrade! There are 4 main upgrade categories:
[list][*]The shop: upgrade the shop by adding additional displays, storage racks, trash cans and decorations, or expand your floor space by adding entirely new floors.
[*]The truck: upgrade the crafting stations inside your truck to craft higher quality goods, and improve your truck's drill, dirt capacity and consumables to improve your mining efficiency.
[*]Mechs & Compation Bots: purchase and upgrade mechs and companion bots and acquire perks to improve their stats and abilities.
[*]Your character: your character levels up as you mine, earning you skill points used to improve your mining stats. These stats apply to any mech you enter![/list][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45741194/71705fb2595ddc4ef8f69dc7c162d6401ad070ac.gif"][/img]

[h3]Story[/h3]
The story of Mining Merchant starts when you get called in to help your uncle in the big city. Your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and he needs your help to bring it back to life.

But as you explore the underground and expand your shop, you quickly realize there's more than meets the eye. Mysterious earthquakes happen every night at midnight, collapsing the tunnels you dug the other day, thus keeping you from reaching new depths. But what's causing this, and why?

[h3]Please wishlist![/h3]
In the coming months, I’ll be writing dedicated devblogs for each of the topics above. Make sure you don’t miss anything by adding the game to your Steam wishlist and following the Mining Merchant Community Hub. Got questions or thoughts? Drop them in the comments below or ping me on Discord!

notes.title: Announcing my new game: Mining Merchant!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Great news; today I'm announcing my new game, Mining Merchant! As the title suggests, this is indeed a spin-off of (Super) Mining Mechs, but this time the focus is on crafting and shopkeeping.

In Mining Merchant, your uncle’s once-thriving jewelry shop is crumbling, and it’s your job to bring it back to life! Mine precious ore, smelt it into shiny jewelry, add rare gemstones and sell to every customer who walks in. Mine by day, sell by night, solo or in co-op, and become a successful merchant!

You can watch the new gameplay trailer below, but before you do, please [b]add the game to your Steam wishlist[/b] to be notified when it launches!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744080/Mining_Merchant/"][/dynamiclink]

[h3]Mining Merchant - Gameplay Trailer[/h3]
[previewyoutube="tg023Gf86oQ;full"][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Gameplay loop[/h3]
In Mining Merchant, the gameplay loop consists of two core phases, which you can play at your own pace.

Each day starts with the "mining phase", in which you explore underground caverns and mine valuable resources in the traditionally satisfying and chill Mining Mechs style. Those resources are then crafted into jewelry to sell in your shop. There are several crafting stations that make up the process, but I’ll go into more detail about that in a future post. 

Once you’ve finished crafting, you return to the shop to enter the "shopkeeping phase". Stock your shelves, open your doors, and start selling! Customers will come in looking for specific pieces and some might even request custom orders!

The money you earn can be used to upgrade your shop, your mechs, and more, prepping you for even bigger hauls the next day!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/ed86f689d9d914c1e7d8b5e513d60382b6f92bd2.gif[/img]

[h3]Why Mining Merchant?[/h3]
The reason I've decided to go in this direction is because over the years, I’ve gotten a ton of feedback from the community, and one thing stood out: repetitiveness. Both Mining Mechs and Super Mining Mechs are grindy games, and while many players enjoy the relaxing vibe, I think we can all agree that a little more variety wouldn’t hurt ;)

So while Mining Merchant is still primarily a mining game, the crafting and shopkeeping phases shake up the formula and add something fresh.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/cfa50114810b4fac2a06add5b46349f7d16d1734.gif[/img]

[h3]Please wishlist![/h3]
I hope the game caught your interest! If it did, please consider adding the game to your Steam wishlist so you’ll get a notification when it launches, and it really helps me out!

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3744080/Mining_Merchant/" style="button" buttoncolor="#75b022"][h1]Wishlist Mining Merchant![/h1][/url]

Lastly, I’d love to hear your thoughts! If you have any suggestions or questions, feel free to drop them in the comments here, over on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3744080/discussions/]Mining Merchant Community Hub[/url], or [url=https://discord.gg/PyRmFttgrS]ping me on Discord[/url]!

notes.title: New base game content ahead of DLC release!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey everyone![/h3]
Hope you're all doing great! With the upcoming DLC content planned for Friday, I wanted to make sure there's something new to play in the base game as well. So today I'm showcasing a (free) base game content update that's coming tomorrow, one day ahead of the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2830150/view/523081237389116264]upcoming DLCs[/url]. 

Tomorrow's content update includes the following:
[list][*]2 new maps
[*]A new 'rock' type
[*]10 Trading cards
[*]5 New achievements[/list]
[h3]New maps[/h3]
There are two new maps, one on planet Frostera and one on planet Vulcanar. These are the fourth maps on each planet and will unlock after completing the third maps. They also include additional mines so you can build new mining sites for additional passive resources.
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/683a89efee1345af8013727ae15804f3593b8923.png[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/8ff193ec94eaf6a7cdebe3462e6eaf5947084ee1.png[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[h3]New 'rock' type[/h3]
You might be wondering how a new type of rock could possibly be interesting, however, this rock is actually diggable! You'll encounter these rocks on Frostera and Vulcanar. Although you can dig right through them without the need of any bombs, they will freeze or overheat your mech, so you need to cool down for a bit until you can continue. Of course the overheating and freezing passives will help you cool down much faster!
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/c81a2230ad3e8877ece5f9a52b181e5bd25747a7.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/49fadad34aee4eea661fde62ac65d95bea15ecdf.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[h3]Trading Cards[/h3]
Starting from tomorrow, Super Mining Mechs will have Steam trading cards enabled, which means you will randomly find cards as you play the game. Turn them into an awesome badge to unlock Steam wallpapers and emoji's to spice up your Steam profile.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/00c021b49f859151feee8aa3636ab994b4863ee1.png[/img]
[h3]New achievements[/h3]
By popular request, I'm adding a handful of achievements as well. I got asked many times to add new achievements in the DLC, but sadly it's not possible to add seperate achievements to DLC content. This means that if I would add achievements that require the DLC content, it would become impossible for players to get 100% of the achievements without purchasing the DLC. I don't think it's fair to force people to get the DLC just to get the achievements, so I won't be adding any new achievements tied to the new DLC content. However, of course it's still possible to expand the range of achievements of the base game, so I'm adding 5 new achievements!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/e0859a2f7baffcae646e967db3547c05a3b00dae.png[/img]
[h3]Please Wishlist![/h3]
Lastly - please don't forget to wishlist the upcoming DLC / soundtrack. It helps out a lot for the Steam algorithm and makes sure you get notified when they launch this Friday. This way you won't miss the launch discount!

And as always - thank you all for your continued support! <3

notes.title: DLC Release Date & Content Reveal!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Hope you're having a great first month of the year! I've been making great progress with the upcoming DLCs for both Mining Mechs and Super Mining Mechs, and so today I'd like to share that both DLCs are set to launch on Friday February 28th. 

In this post I'm zooming in on Super Mining Mechs - Toxic Treasures. But first, please take some time to wishlist both DLC here to be notified when they launch! It also helps a lot for the Steam algorithm :)

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379790/Mining_Mechs__Camel_Chaos/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379430/Super_Mining_Mechs__Toxic_Treasures/

[h3]About Toxic Treasures[/h3]
The DLC adds a brand new planet to Super Mining Mechs called "Toxera", which is a dangerous and toxic place full of acid. You receive a distress call from Doctor Dica, a German scientist who's underground laboratory is flooded with acid. He asks you to dive down in a special submarine mech to restore his labs, but can you really trust him?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/fe008866de5e7f0bd84329b99ba7fe2b728d2116.png[/img]

Naturally, you can upgrade and customize your submarine mech to increase your underwater (or should I say under-acid) mining speed. However - that doesn't mean your old trusty super mining mech is not useful on Toxera either, as you can drain the acid by restoring pumps, draining the acid from certain regions and allowing for your regular mech to mine there. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/db4e3cc24aa2b6524a8d297f232035b9bbd67466.png[/img]

Toxera contains 20 brand new resources to find in the Lanthanide and Actinide element groups. And of course - once cleared of acid - you can build mines on this planet to mine them passively.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/97373dc09f944d64e60d6a56aa02a1b5ab2e8805.png[/img]

While underwater, you can move around freely in any direction - which also means you can mine in any direction - even upwards! That's right, I know many of you have requested for mechs to be able to mine upwards, so here you go! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/d040c299142e0d19d921c0b1f5cb80f72fefbce2.png[/img]

[h3]Pricing:[/h3]
Mining Mechs - Camel Chaos: [b]$0.99[/b]
Super Mining Mechs - Toxic Treasures: [b]$1.99[/b]
Both DLCs will have a launch discount, and there will also be a bundle to get an additional discount when you get both DLCs at once!

[h3]Testing[/h3]
Want to help me test the upcoming DLCs? Awesome! We're still actively looking for enthusiastic testers. For more information check out the #announcements channel in our Discord.
[url=https://discord.com/invite/RKpJp8Huvx style=button]Discord[/url]

[h3]Please Wishlist![/h3]
Lastly - please don't forget to wishlist both DLC. It helps out a lot for the Steam algorithm and makes sure you get notified when they launch. This way you won't miss the launch discount!

And as always - thank you all for your continued support! I'd love to hear your thoughts on the upcoming DLC and if you have any questions please feel free to ask them below! :)
-Barry

notes.title: New DLC announcement!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

I'm really excited to announce two new adventures coming to the Mining Mechs franchise, as I'm announcing not one, but [u]two[/u] new DLCs today; one for Super Mining Mechs and one for the original Mining Mechs. That's right! I've not forgotten about the original just yet and I've decided to release a new DLC for the original game alongside the new DLC for Super Mining Mechs.

[h2]Please wishlist![/h2]
Before you read on, please take some time to wishlist both DLC here to be notified when they launch! It also helps a lot for the Steam algorithm :)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379790/Mining_Mechs__Camel_Chaos/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379430/Super_Mining_Mechs__Toxic_Treasures/

[h2]Overview[/h2]
So what does each DLC include exactly?
[table noborder=0 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Mining Mechs[/h3]
Chamel Chaos DLC[/td]
        [td][h3]Super Mining Mechs[/h3]
Toxic Treasures DLC[/td]
    [/tr]
    [tr]
[td][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379790/Mining_Mechs__Camel_Chaos/ style=button]Add to your wishlist![/url][/td]
[td][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3379430/Super_Mining_Mechs__Toxic_Treasures/ style=button]Add to your wishlist![/url][/td]
    [/tr]
        [td]Includes:
[list][*]A new map
[*]A new storyline
[*]New quests
[*]14 new resources
[*]5 new mechs
[*]Tons of camels![/list][/td]
        [td]Includes:
[list][*]A new toxic planet
[*]4 new maps
[*]A new storyline
[*]New missions
[*]New resources
[*]New mech modules[/list][/td]
    [tr]
        [td]Price: $0.99*[/td]
        [td]Price $1.99*[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
*region pricing applies. price will differ based on currency and location according to Steam's suggested price conversion.

[h2]Why paid DLC?[/h2]
I'd also like to take some time to address the elephant in the room; why paid DLC? As a gamer myself I understand that paying for stuff is never fun. That's why I've been pushing out a lot of patches and updates for free over the past months. However, with the base price of both games being so low, it's not possible for me to sustain these games with this type of new content in the long run, as that's simply not profitable. Making games takes a lot of time and costs a lot of money, and since the content included in these DLCs requires an investment from my end, I'd be at a loss if it was free. That's why I've settled on the lowest possible price point of 99 cents and 1.99 to hopefully keep it as accessible as possible for everyone. I'll also make sure to include a launch discount and add them to a bundle, so you get an additional discount on top of the launch discount if you already own the game through the  [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/46085/Mining_Mechs__Complete_Franchise/]Complete Franchise Bundle[/url]. I hope you understand my decision and thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We just hit an awesome milestone; 100 million total tiles mined globally!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/a8c8a80c7448bb013499309abc0d8e76a17ba4d2.gif[/img]

I figured this would be a good time to look back at what happened since launch and what I'll be focusing on going forward.

[h2]So far[/h2]
Since launch I've pushed about 10 patches with a bunch of fixes, changes and improvements. I want to thank you all for the feedback and suggestions as it really helps me improve the game and focus on what's most important! The hat poll from last week has also ended; and with more than 500 votes you guys have voted for the Wizard's Hat. The hat will automatically unlock next time you start the game! :)

[h2]So what's next? [/h2]
So far I've been focusing on quick small patches, to make sure important improvements and bug fixes are implemented asap. However, as I'm starting to move on from bug fixing and improvements to new features and content, I'll be focusing on releasing bigger patches less frequently. So far I've planned 3 big updates.

I don't have any deadlines for these updates because I want to take my time to polish things up and release it when it's ready. I prefer a delayed victory over a quick failure. 

The contents of these updates are based on suggestions and feedback from the community. A lot of suggestions and feedback have been implemented right away, but the bigger / more complicated changes have been put in one of the updates below. These updates are subject to change and I'd love to hear what you would like to see in upcoming updates so I can update the roadmap!

[h3]Update #1[/h3]
[list]
[*] New map
[*] New rock type
[*] Stats & leaderboards
[*] Radar zoom passive
[*] Bank expansion passive
[*] Passive prestiges
[*] Passive cross-saving
[*] Deliver all option for buildings
[*] Improved controller support
[*] Improved Steam Deck support
[*] New hats
[*] New horn sounds
[*] Got any other suggestions? Let me know!
[/list]
[h3]Update #2[/h3]
[list]
[*] New map
[*] Ice nodes
[*] Animals (scenic, not pets)
[*] Repeatable objectives
[*] Mech skins & customization
[*] New hats
[*] New horn sounds
[*] Got any other suggestions? Let me know!
[/list]
[h3]Update #3[/h3]
[list]
[*] New map
[*] Magma nodes
[*] Weather effects
[*] Daily / Weekly challenges
[*] New hats
[*] New horn sounds
[*] Got any other suggestions? Let me know!
[/list]

Lastly, it's probably good to mention that after these free updates I'll be focusing my attention on DLC content. With the game being priced as low as it is, it's not in the budget for me to endlessly keep pushing out free updates and content. However, if I can release new content in the form of a paid DLC (probably priced around $1.99 or something) I can keep working on the game for a longer period of time. That obviously won't mean the base game is not getting any free content or updates anymore after the three updates above. I'll keep updating and patching the game just like I'm still actively pushing out patches for the prequel.

Thank you all for the continued support!
-Barry

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.00.75
notes.content:
Another update with a bunch of fixes and QoL updates. I have been getting reports from players mentioning their game sometimes closes out without an error message. This makes it hard to fix, because the error message usually contains all the info I need to fix the problem. I have spent multiple days investigating this, involving various people (better coders than I am) to get to the bottom of this. It's my main priority. However, I am not able to reproduce the issue for myself. Because of this, I am not able to confirm if my changes and fixes work. Therefore I currently completely rely on everyone to keep reporting if it still happens. So I have a request for anyone that has ever encountered this issue before: please get this latest patch and disable visual effects through the settings menu. If you still get a crash without visual effects on, please let me know! This way we can confirm that the issue is not with the visual effects and will bring me one step closer to narrowing down the root of the issue. In the meantime I have added a setting to increase the auto save interval, so if the game does crash, you don't lose too much progress. 

Thanks for your patience and support! Really appreciate all the feedback I've been getting through Steam and Discord!

notes.title: Devlog #5: Building
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

In this week's Devlog I'd like to share an exciting new feature in Super Mining Mechs; Base Building! 

(PS: if you haven't added the game to your wishlist yet, please do so! this way you'll be notified when the game launches)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/ style=button]+ Wishlist[/url]

[h3]Building Basics[/h3]
Let's start with the basics; what do buildings do and how does it work? Building underground allows you to build bases that you can use for all sorts of stuff. To start building, simply select what you want to build from your building selector (which is similar to the item selector) and place it on the ground. Once placed, you need to construct it by delivering the right materials. Each building requires a certain amount of resources from specified categories of the period table of elements (indicated by the color). You can choose what resources from within the required categories you want to deliver. Once delivered, you can complete the construction!

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Power[/h3]
The first building you need is a power plant, which is used to power all the other buildings. It draws its power from an energy crystal, which can be found throughout the map by their glowing roots. Once dig up, you can place a power plant on top and deliver the right materials to construct it. From there, you can run a cable to your buildings using connectors.[/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/230830fedab490edc5ebbc9aac9f0d161e1be9ad.gif[/img][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/af2139a71c198ef9b3cede87747cfa38c0b8509a.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][h3]Mines[/h3]
Mines are the most important buildings in Super Mining Mechs, as they can mine resources autonomously and they are the map objectives. Similar to how power plants can only be built on top of energy crystals, mines can only be built on mining sites, located in caves. Once constructed, the mine can be powered by running a power line from the power plant to the mine, and there you go; passive mining![/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Platforms[/h3]
Platforms were probably one of the most requested features in Mining Mechs, as you cannot dig while flying, which sometimes makes it hard to reach valuable resources. Luckily the building mechanic offers a good solution for this. You can now build platforms on any location from which you can dig left or right![/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/81b3e6ad06cca155d18b3cbbb64e4eb0df3d99b5.gif[/img][/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/6223ecb4bf8b2619f2753e85f59266726932f8d0.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][h3]Radar[/h3]
Another much requested feature was a mini map, so I'm happy to say I've added a radar that enables the mini map for its surrounding environment. As you can see in the start of the video, the mini map is not receiving any signal. Then, when the radar tower is constructed and powered, you can see the mini map turning on.[/td][/tr]
[/table]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][h3]Portal[/h3]
Although the teleporter item can be used to quickly move above ground from any point underground, it's not possible to get back down. The advantage of a portal is that it can be used in two directions, so you can get back up to your pod quickly, drop stuff off, and get back down quickly.[/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/04b83a07e98d3d9ac081979e6f618b9d77ad7939.gif[/img][/td][/tr]
[/table]

There's a couple more buildings but we'll cover those in a later devlog as they are related to another new feature I want to cover seperately! Hope you guys are enjoying these devlogs - if so, please feel free to drop a comment below. Want to vote on the next devlog topic, or suggest a feature? Join the Discord or leave a comment below!

notes.title: Devlog #3: Digging & Gathering
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

This Devlog is about a small but very important update to the game changing the way resources are gathered. One of the things I personally love most about Mining Mechs is that it's relaxing and satisfying. I'm always trying to tweak and optimize this to see how I can make the game the game even more satisfying and I think this update is a really good example of that, so I figured I'd share this with you all this week.

(PS: if you haven't added the game to your wishlist yet, please do so! this way you'll be notified when the game launches)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/ style=button]+ Wishlist[/url]

Little disclaimer before I start; please keep in mind that this part of the game is still in active development. There are placeholders / missing things in all of the GIFs and everything is subject to change.

[h3]Early game[/h3]
When you're just starting out your mining speed will be low. This is not much different from the previous Mining Mechs game, with the exception of the digging being continuous and the gathered resources popping up over your head.
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/4135f608f3741f36d44ef6c3ee223281a6a9093d.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/6ce34b870ceda0d2d235a88ef4e13d2931f3a7a0.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
[h3]Late game[/h3]
Now this is what it would look like with a late game build. As you can see here you can cut through dirt like butter and you gather multiple resources with each ore you mine. In a matter of seconds you can now gather what previously took minutes. You can also see the color and animation of the text change based on the combo you get.
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/82392e363cc136638583150f88e1867fae94efab.gif[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/480de8a0fc14230c0a6185689a6b3c109191387e.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]
Of course getting to the end game parts will take a long time and the progress will be gradual. I would love to know what you all think of this update. I'm considering adding a combo bonus to the gathered resources too so that for example there'd be a multiplier bonus when you hit a combo chain of 100.

Alright, that's all I have to share for now. Want to vote on the next devlog topic, or suggest a feature? Join the Discord or leave a comment below!

notes.title: Devlog #1: Mech Customization
notes.content:
Hey everyone! First of all, a huge thank you to all of you for the positive response to the announcement of Super Mining Mechs. The amount of wishlists far exceeded my expectations and it's really motivating to see so many people exited for the game.

(PS: if you haven't added the game to your wishlist yet, please do so! this way you'll be notified when the game launches)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2830150/Super_Mining_Mechs/ style=button]+ Wishlist[/url]

Since the announcement, I've received a lot of questions from people wondering what exactly making Super Mining Mechs so Super, so in the coming months I'll regularly be posting small devlogs to highlight new features from the game. In a [url=https://discord.gg/JJEXTyw4]Discord[/url] poll you all voted that I kick this off with a post about Customization, so here we go.

[h3]Modules[/h3]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td]Let's start with the basics. Mechs consist of 6 different modules, categorized as; chassis, movement, flight, storage, dirt tank and digging. You unlock new parts by completing missions, after which you have to purchase them in order to equip them. I'm currently aiming to have at least 10 parts in each category on launch, which would make for a total of 1.000.000 possible unique mech combinations. PS: The screenshots and GIFs are still lacking in variety, as I'm still in the process of adding more modules to the game.[/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/e206b85595e84fec8c486b0d59fc314b6de062bd.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h3]Weight[/h3]
[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/90434c993b9f0fbafb430936528bdb2baee02576.gif[/img][/td]
        [td]Each modules has its own weight and its own stats. Each chassis module has a weight limit, which limits the total amount of weight all the other modules can have. How you distribute this weight is up to you; choosing a heavy drill will help you mine extra fast, or pick a heavy storage container so you can hold out longer.

In the GIF to the left here you can see the yellow weight limit indicator moving when choosing a different chassis module. This new chassis module also impacts the flight speed though!
[/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

[h3]Stats[/h3]
Each mech has the following stats:
[list]
    [*]Weight: The chassis module defines the weight limit (yellow line) and the weight of all the other parts combined has to stay within this limit.
    [*]Mining Power: Determines how fast you can mine. Deeper layers will require more mining power.
    [*]Flight: How fast you can fly up but also how fast you can fall down. Some flight modules also impact your weight limit.
    [*]Movement Speed: How fast you can walk / drive around. Similar to flight modules, some movement modules also impact your weight limit.
    [*]Inventory: Impacts the amount of resources you can carry.
    [*]Dirt: Impacts the amount of dirt you can carry.
    [*]Items: Impacts the amount of items you can carry. There is no dedicated category for item modules, but some chassis, inventory or dirt modules impact this stat too.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066482/335b409deb70d81c248ac586897862547c8a2067.gif[/img]

Alright, that's all I have to share for now. Want to vote on the next devlog topic, or suggest a feature? Join the Discord or leave a comment below!
